{"summary":"Implemented triage.sh to parse logs, filter errors, deduplicate by signature, and output grouped counts.","files":[{"path":"scripts/triage.sh","content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if [[ $# -ne 1 ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <logfile>"
    exit 1
fi

logfile="$1"

if [[ ! -f "$logfile" ]]; then
    echo "Error: File not found: $logfile"
    exit 1
fi

# Extract ERROR lines, normalize signatures, count occurrences, and output grouped results
awk '
    /ERROR/ {
        # Extract the message part after the log level
        msg = $0
        # Remove timestamp and level prefix to get the signature
        # Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ LEVEL Message
        sub(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z ERROR /, "", msg)
        
        # Count occurrences of this signature
        count[msg]++
    }
    END {
        # Sort and print results
        n = asorti(count, sorted)
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            sig = sorted[i]
            cnt = count[sig]
            print cnt " " sig
        }
    }
' "$logfile"
"}]
